13from __future__ import annotations

15import colorsys
16import csv
17import math
18from dataclasses import dataclass
19from datetime import datetime

21from typing import Iterable

24@dataclass(slots=True)
25class _LogRow:
26 timestamp: datetime
27 channel: int
28 voltage_v: float
29 current_a: float
30 power_w: float
31 charge_ah: float
32 energy_wh: float
33
34
35class LogPlotLoader:
36 """Loads one or more log CSV files and returns series payload for QML charts."""
37
38 _METRIC_KEYS = ("voltage_v", "current_a", "power_w", "charge_ah", "energy_wh")
39
40 _CHANNEL_BASE_RGB = {
41 1: (214, 211, 58),
42 2: (70, 204, 90),
43 3: (57, 168, 255),
44 4: (209, 90, 240),
45 }
46
47 def __init__(self, max_points_per_series: int = 1800) -> None:
48 self._max_points_per_series = max(150, int(max_points_per_series))
49
50 def load_csv_files(self, paths: Iterable[str | Path]) -> dict:
51 normalized_paths = self._normalize_paths(paths)
52 if not normalized_paths:
53 raise ValueError("No se seleccionaron archivos CSV")
54
55 series_by_metric = {metric: [] for metric in self._METRIC_KEYS}
56 total_rows = 0
57 max_duration_s = 0.0
58 global_start_ts: datetime | None = None
59 global_end_ts: datetime | None = None
60 loaded_files: list[str] = []
61
62 for file_index, path in enumerate(normalized_paths):
63 rows = self._read_rows(path)
64 if not rows:
65 continue
66
67 loaded_files.append(str(path))
68 total_rows += len(rows)
69 rows.sort(key=lambda item: item.timestamp)
70 file_start_ts = rows[0].timestamp
71 file_end_ts = rows[-1].timestamp
72 file_duration_s = max(0.0, (rows[-1].timestamp - file_start_ts).total_seconds())
73 max_duration_s = max(max_duration_s, file_duration_s)
74 if global_start_ts is None or file_start_ts < global_start_ts:
75 global_start_ts = file_start_ts
76 if global_end_ts is None or file_end_ts > global_end_ts:
77 global_end_ts = file_end_ts
78
79 channel_rows: dict[int, list[_LogRow]] = {}
80 for row in rows:
81 channel_rows.setdefault(row.channel, []).append(row)
82
83 for channel, group in sorted(channel_rows.items()):
84 group.sort(key=lambda item: item.timestamp)
85 elapsed_values = [max(0.0, (item.timestamp - file_start_ts).total_seconds()) for item in group]
86
87 label = f"{path.name} | CH{channel}"
88 color = self._series_color(channel=channel, file_index=file_index)
89
90 for metric in self._METRIC_KEYS:
91 points = [
92 {
93 "x": elapsed,
94 "y": float(getattr(item, metric)),
95 }
96 for elapsed, item in zip(elapsed_values, group)
97 ]
98 points = self._decimate(points)
99
100 series_by_metric[metric].append(
101 {
102 "name": label,
103 "file": str(path),
104 "channel": channel,
105 "color": color,
106 "points": points,
107 }
108 )
109
110 if not loaded_files:
111 raise ValueError("Los CSV seleccionados están vacíos o no tienen filas válidas")
112
113 return {
114 "files": loaded_files,
115 "file_count": len(loaded_files),
116 "sample_count": total_rows,
117 "duration_s": max_duration_s,
118 "global_start_iso": (
119 global_start_ts.isoformat(timespec="milliseconds")
120 if global_start_ts is not None
121 else ""
122 ),
123 "global_end_iso": (
124 global_end_ts.isoformat(timespec="milliseconds")
125 if global_end_ts is not None
126 else ""
127 ),
128 "series": series_by_metric,
129 }
130
131 def _normalize_paths(self, raw_paths: Iterable[str | Path]) -> list[Path]:
132 normalized: list[Path] = []
133 seen: set[Path] = set()
134
135 for raw in raw_paths:
136 text = str(raw).strip()
137 if not text:
138 continue
139 path = Path(text).expanduser().resolve()
140 if path in seen:
141 continue
142 if not path.exists() or not path.is_file():
143 raise FileNotFoundError(f"Archivo no encontrado: {path}")
144 if path.suffix.lower() != ".csv":
145 continue
146 normalized.append(path)
147 seen.add(path)
148
149 return normalized
150
151 def _read_rows(self, path: Path) -> list[_LogRow]:
152 rows: list[_LogRow] = []
153
154 with path.open("r", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
155 reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
156 required_headers = {
157 "timestamp_iso",
158 "channel",
159 "voltage_v",
160 "current_a",
161 "power_w",
162 "charge_ah",
163 "energy_wh",
164 }
165
166 available_headers = set(reader.fieldnames or [])
167 missing = required_headers - available_headers
168 if missing:
169 missing_text = ", ".join(sorted(missing))
170 raise ValueError(f"CSV inválido '{path.name}', faltan columnas: {missing_text}")
171
172 for raw in reader:
173 try:
174 timestamp = self._parse_timestamp(raw["timestamp_iso"])
175 rows.append(
176 _LogRow(
177 timestamp=timestamp,
178 channel=int(float(raw["channel"])),
179 voltage_v=float(raw["voltage_v"]),
180 current_a=float(raw["current_a"]),
181 power_w=float(raw["power_w"]),
182 charge_ah=float(raw["charge_ah"]),
183 energy_wh=float(raw["energy_wh"]),
184 )
185 )
186 except Exception:
187 # Skip malformed rows and keep loading valid data.
188 continue
189
190 return rows
191
192 def _parse_timestamp(self, raw_value: str) -> datetime:
193 token = str(raw_value).strip()
194 if not token:
195 raise ValueError("timestamp vacío")
196 if token.endswith("Z"):
197 token = token[:-1] + "+00:00"
198 return datetime.fromisoformat(token)
199
200 def _decimate(self, points: list[dict[str, float]]) -> list[dict[str, float]]:
201 if len(points) <= self._max_points_per_series:
202 return points
203
204 # Keep extrema per bucket so Y scale/shape stay faithful while reducing point count.
205 target_pairs = max(1, self._max_points_per_series // 2)
206 bucket_size = max(1, int(math.ceil(len(points) / target_pairs)))
207
208 reduced: list[dict[str, float]] = []
209 for start_idx in range(0, len(points), bucket_size):
210 bucket = points[start_idx:start_idx + bucket_size]
211 if not bucket:
212 continue
213
214 min_point = bucket[0]
215 max_point = bucket[0]
216 for point in bucket[1:]:
217 if point["y"] < min_point["y"]:
218 min_point = point
219 if point["y"] > max_point["y"]:
220 max_point = point
221
222 if min_point["x"] <= max_point["x"]:
223 reduced.append(min_point)
224 if max_point is not min_point:
225 reduced.append(max_point)
226 else:
227 reduced.append(max_point)
228 if max_point is not min_point:
229 reduced.append(min_point)
230
231 if reduced and reduced[-1] is not points[-1]:
232 reduced.append(points[-1])
233
234 if len(reduced) > self._max_points_per_series:
235 stride = int(math.ceil(len(reduced) / self._max_points_per_series))
236 reduced = [reduced[idx] for idx in range(0, len(reduced), stride)]
237 if reduced and reduced[-1] is not points[-1]:
238 reduced.append(points[-1])
239 return reduced[: self._max_points_per_series]
240
241 return reduced
242
243 def _series_color(self, channel: int, file_index: int) -> str:
244 red, green, blue = self._CHANNEL_BASE_RGB.get(int(channel), (120, 196, 255))
245 hue, lightness, saturation = colorsys.rgb_to_hls(red / 255.0, green / 255.0, blue / 255.0)
246
247 # Offset color per file to keep same channel recognizable but distinct in legend.
248 hue = (hue + (file_index * 0.085)) % 1.0
249 lightness = min(0.76, max(0.32, lightness + ((file_index % 3) - 1) * 0.06))
250
251 out_r, out_g, out_b = colorsys.hls_to_rgb(hue, lightness, saturation)
252 return f"#{int(out_r * 255):02X}{int(out_g * 255):02X}{int(out_b * 255):02X}"
